definition.sw: Pesa ya kidijitali isiyotolewa na serikali wala kampuni yoyote. Sheria zake ziko kwenye programu huria inayoendeshwa na maelfu ya kompyuta duniani.
definition.en: Digital money that no government or company issues. Its rules live in open-source software run by thousands of computers around the world.

definition.sw: Kipimo kidogo zaidi cha bitcoin. Bitcoin moja ina sats milioni 100.
definition.en: The smallest unit of bitcoin. One bitcoin is 100 million sats.

definition.sw: Programu au kifaa kinachohifadhi funguo zako na kukuwezesha kutuma na kupokea bitcoin. Pochi haihifadhi sarafu zenyewe.
definition.en: An app or device that stores your keys and lets you send and receive bitcoin. It doesn't hold the coins themselves.

definition.sw: Maneno 12 au 24 yanayoweza kurejesha funguo zote za pochi yako. Anayeyajua ndiye mmiliki wa pesa.
definition.en: 12 or 24 words that can restore every key in your wallet. Whoever knows them owns the money.

definition.sw: Nambari ya siri inayotia sahihi malipo yako. Usimpe mtu yeyote.
definition.en: A secret number that signs your payments. Never give it to anyone.

definition.sw: Nambari inayotokana na ufunguo binafsi. Wengine huitumia kuthibitisha sahihi yako bila kujua siri yako.
definition.en: A number derived from your private key. Others use it to check your signature without learning your secret.

definition.sw: Mfuatano wa herufi unaompa mtu ili akutumie bitcoin, kama nambari ya simu ya M-Pesa.
definition.en: A string you give someone so they can send you bitcoin, like an M-Pesa phone number.

definition.sw: Kushika funguo zako mwenyewe, bila kumtegemea mtu mwingine kuzilinda.
definition.en: Holding your own keys, without relying on anyone else to keep them.

definition.sw: Pochi ambayo kampuni au mtu mwingine anashika funguo kwa niaba yako.
definition.en: A wallet where a company or another person holds the keys for you.

definition.sw: Noti za kidijitali zinazowakilisha bitcoin iliyoshikwa na shirikisho. Malipo yake ni ya faragha.
definition.en: Digital notes that stand for bitcoin held by a federation. Payments with them are private.

definition.sw: Programu huria inayoruhusu jumuiya kuendesha shirikisho linaloshika bitcoin kwa pamoja na kutoa ecash.
definition.en: Open-source software that lets a community run a federation that holds bitcoin together and issues ecash.

definition.sw: Kikundi cha walinzi wanaoshika bitcoin kwa pamoja; wengi wao lazima wakubaliane kabla pesa kusonga.
definition.en: A group of guardians who hold bitcoin together; most of them must agree before money moves.

definition.sw: Mwanachama wa shirikisho anayeendesha seva na kushika sehemu ya funguo.
definition.en: A member of a federation who runs a server and holds part of the keys.

definition.sw: Mpangilio ambapo sahihi kadhaa zinahitajika ili kutumia bitcoin, kwa mfano 2 kati ya 3.
definition.en: A setup where several signatures are needed to spend bitcoin, for example 2 of 3.

definition.sw: Mtandao juu ya Bitcoin unaowezesha malipo ya haraka na ada ndogo sana.
definition.en: A network on top of Bitcoin for fast payments with very small fees.

definition.sw: Ombi la malipo la Lightning, mara nyingi kama msimbo wa QR, lenye kiasi na muda wa kuisha.
definition.en: A Lightning payment request, often shown as a QR code, with an amount and an expiry time.

definition.sw: Uhusiano wa malipo kati ya nodi mbili za Lightning, uliofungwa kwa muamala wa Bitcoin.
definition.en: A payment link between two Lightning nodes, locked by a Bitcoin transaction.

definition.sw: Kompyuta inayoendesha programu ya Bitcoin au Lightning na kukagua sheria zote yenyewe.
definition.en: A computer running Bitcoin or Lightning software that checks every rule for itself.

definition.sw: Daftari la pamoja la miamala yote ya Bitcoin, linalohifadhiwa na nodi kote duniani.
definition.en: The shared record of every Bitcoin transaction, kept by nodes around the world.

definition.sw: Kundi la miamala linaloongezwa kwenye blockchain takriban kila dakika 10.
definition.en: A batch of transactions added to the blockchain about every 10 minutes.

definition.sw: Kazi ya kompyuta zinazoshindana kuongeza bloku inayofuata na kulipwa bitcoin mpya na ada.
definition.en: Computers competing to add the next block, paid in new bitcoin and fees.

definition.sw: Kila bloku 210,000 (takriban miaka minne), zawadi ya bitcoin mpya kwa wachimbaji hupungua nusu.
definition.en: Every 210,000 blocks (about four years) the new-bitcoin reward for miners is cut in half.

definition.sw: Ujumbe uliotiwa sahihi unaohamisha bitcoin kutoka kwa matokeo ya zamani kwenda kwa wamiliki wapya.
definition.en: A signed message that moves bitcoin from old outputs to new owners.

definition.sw: Matokeo ya muamala ambayo bado hayajatumika: kipande cha bitcoin unachoweza kutumia.
definition.en: Unspent transaction output: a piece of bitcoin you can spend.

definition.sw: Kiasi kidogo unacholipa ili muamala wako uingizwe kwenye bloku au upite kwenye Lightning.
definition.en: A small amount you pay to get your transaction into a block or routed over Lightning.

definition.sw: Muamala unapoingizwa kwenye bloku hupata uthibitisho mmoja; kila bloku inayofuata huongeza mmoja.
definition.en: A transaction gets one confirmation when it enters a block; each later block adds another.

definition.sw: Foleni ya miamala inayosubiri kuingizwa kwenye bloku.
definition.en: The queue of transactions waiting to get into a block.

definition.sw: Jinsi bei inavyobadilika haraka na kwa kiasi kikubwa, juu au chini.
definition.en: How quickly and how far a price moves, up or down.

definition.sw: Bei za bidhaa kupanda kwa muda, hivyo pesa ile ile inanunua vitu vichache.
definition.en: Prices rising over time, so the same money buys less.

definition.sw: Kikundi cha watu wanaoweka akiba au kuwekeza pamoja kwa sheria walizokubaliana.
definition.en: A group of people who save or invest together under rules they agreed on.

definition.sw: Hila ya kukudanganya ili utoe pesa au siri zako.
definition.en: A trick to fool you into handing over money or secrets.

definition.sw: Ujumbe au tovuti bandia inayojifanya kuwa huduma halali ili kuiba siri zako.
definition.en: A fake message or website pretending to be a real service to steal your secrets.

definition.sw: Waraka wa kurasa tisa wa Satoshi Nakamoto (2008) ulioeleza Bitcoin kwa mara ya kwanza.
definition.en: Satoshi Nakamoto's nine-page paper (2008) that first described Bitcoin.

definition.sw: Kampuni inayokuuzia au kukununulia bitcoin kwa shilingi; kwa kawaida ni mtunzaji.
definition.en: A company that sells you bitcoin for shillings or buys it from you; usually a custodian.

definition.sw: Mraba wa vitone unaosomwa na kamera ya simu, mara nyingi una anwani au ankara.
definition.en: A square of dots a phone camera can read, often holding an address or invoice.

definition.sw: Nakala ya maneno yako ya siri iliyohifadhiwa mahali salama ili urejeshe pochi.
definition.en: A copy of your seed phrase kept somewhere safe so you can restore your wallet.

definition.sw: Programu ambayo msimbo wake uko wazi kwa yeyote kusoma, kukagua na kuboresha.
definition.en: Software whose code anyone can read, check and improve.

definition.sw: Pendekezo la mabadiliko kwenye mradi wa GitHub, linalokaguliwa kabla ya kuunganishwa.
definition.en: A proposed change to a GitHub project, reviewed before it is merged.

definition.sw: Mtandao binafsi wa majaribio wa Bitcoin unaoudhibiti, unaochimba bloku papo hapo.
definition.en: A private Bitcoin test network you control, where blocks are mined instantly.

definition.sw: Maelezo mafupi yanayoeleza ni anwani zipi pochi inamiliki na jinsi ya kuzitumia.
definition.en: A short description of which addresses a wallet owns and how to spend them.

definition.sw: Mkataba wa hashi wenye kufuli la muda: malipo yanayofunguliwa tu kwa siri sahihi kabla ya muda kuisha.
definition.en: Hash time-locked contract: a payment that unlocks only with the right secret before a deadline.

definition.sw: Siri ambayo hashi yake ni hashi ya malipo. Kuifichua ndiko kunathibitisha kwamba malipo yamefika.
definition.en: The secret whose hash is the payment hash. Revealing it proves the payment arrived.

definition.sw: Kufunga maelekezo ya malipo kwa safu za usimbaji, ili kila nodi ijue hatua inayofuata tu.
definition.en: Wrapping payment instructions in layers of encryption so each node only learns the next hop.

definition.sw: Ujumbe ambao nodi hupeana kuhusu chaneli na nodi zilizopo, ili kila moja ijenge ramani ya mtandao.
definition.en: Messages nodes pass on about existing channels and nodes, so each can build a map of the network.

definition.sw: Uwezo wa kutimiza malipo yanapodaiwa bila ucheleweshaji au hasara isiyokubalika. Kwa soko pia huhusu kufanya biashara bila kuathiri bei sana. Kwa Lightning, uwezo wa kutuma au kupokea hutegemea mwelekeo.
definition.en: Ability to meet a payment when due without an unacceptable delay or loss. Market liquidity also concerns trading without a large price impact. In Lightning, available sending/receiving capacity is direction-dependent.

definition.sw: Muamala uliotiwa sahihi unaoonyesha salio la sasa la chaneli; kila malipo hutengeneza mpya.
definition.en: A signed transaction holding a channel's current balances; every payment makes a new one.

definition.sw: Kufunga chaneli peke yako kwa kuchapisha muamala wa ahadi; pesa zako zinasubiri kufuli la muda.
definition.en: Closing a channel alone by publishing a commitment transaction; your funds wait for a timelock.

definition.sw: Kutuma malipo yasiyoweza kukamilika ili kujua kama njia ina ukwasi wa kutosha.
definition.en: Sending payments that cannot complete to learn whether a route has enough liquidity.

definition.sw: Kiwango cha ankara za Lightning zinazoanza na lnbc (au lnbcrt kwenye regtest).
definition.en: The standard for Lightning invoices that start with lnbc (or lnbcrt on regtest).

definition.sw: Nodi ya Lightning inayounganisha shirikisho la Fedimint na mtandao wa Lightning.
definition.en: A Lightning node that connects a Fedimint federation to the Lightning Network.

definition.sw: Mpango wa mapato, matumizi na muda wake. Kuhamisha kati ya akaunti zako si mapato mapya.
definition.en: A plan for income, expenses and their timing. Transfers between your own accounts are not new income.

definition.sw: Bidhaa na huduma zinazoweza kununuliwa kwa kiasi cha pesa; salio pekee halionyeshi uwezo huo.
definition.en: The goods and services a quantity of money can buy; a nominal balance alone does not show it.

definition.sw: Uwezo wa kutimiza madeni; kulinganisha mali na madeni ni kipimo kimoja, tofauti na kuwa na pesa kwa tarehe fulani. Vipimo vya sheria hutofautiana.
definition.en: Ability to meet financial obligations; comparing assets and liabilities is one assessment, distinct from having cash at a deadline. Actual legal tests vary.

definition.sw: Ushiriki wa chini unaohitajika kwa mkutano au uamuzi halali chini ya kanuni husika; ni tofauti na kura zinazohitajika kupitisha.
definition.en: The minimum participation needed for a valid meeting or decision under the applicable rules; different from votes needed to pass.

definition.sw: Kutenga kuomba, kuidhinisha, kulipa, kurekodi na kukagua ili mtu mmoja asidhibiti na kuficha mchakato mzima.
definition.en: Separating requesting, approving, paying, recording and reviewing so one person cannot control and conceal the entire process.

definition.sw: Mpango wa michango ya mara kwa mara inayounda fungu la mwanachama mmoja kwa kila zamu; anayepokea bado ana wajibu wa kuchangia. Kanuni hutofautiana.
definition.en: An arrangement where periodic contributions form a pot paid to one member each round; members remain obliged to contribute after receiving. Rules differ.

definition.sw: Kutegemea mali, mtoa huduma au chanzo cha kushindwa kinachofanana. Programu kadhaa zinaweza kushiriki hatari ileile ya msingi.
definition.en: Exposure to a shared asset, counterparty or failure source. Several apps can still share the same underlying risk.
